snippet.title: NES Longplay [398] Metal Storm
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: JagOfTroy

This was a pretty fun game to play through with a unique feature that I can't recall seeing in other NES games unless it was only for a particular level.
The first loop is a walk in the park but when it comes to the Expert setting for the game on the second time through, this game takes it personal by kicking your butt at every single moment possible.
Truly hard and very worth while. If you like a challenge, definitely play this one through on the second loop difficulty. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
